name: Kallis Foundry
narrative_role: Officially abandoned industrial site investigated by the Third Measure crew immediately before the Dark Star incident.
canon_observations: The facility had been officially abandoned for approximately nine years.
At least three production floors had been restored covertly.
Restricted reactor material and specialized fabrication activity were present.
Calder Vey was present during the Ranger operation and escaped immediate custody.
Recovered engineering evidence resembled the isolation artifact later encountered aboard the concealed vessel.
staging_hypotheses: Calder Vey was manufacturing a complete replacement Silence artifact.
The foundry's restored systems were built specifically for the dark star containment architecture.
